name: Hyena
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A sandy hyena with dark spots, high shoulders, lower hindquarters, round ears and a blunt muzzle.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), chapter 12, printed and p. 141.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The hyena gains advantage when attacking a creature if a non-incapacitated ally of the hyena is within 5 ft. of the target.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

name: Raven
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A black corvid with a heavy beak, shaggy throat feathers and a slate sheen across its folded wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), chapter 12, printed and p. 150.
sections.Traits: Mimicry. The raven can imitate simple sounds it has heard. A creature hearing the imitation identifies it with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage.
